name: AIR Amarr Explorer
description:
Completion of this AIR skill plan gives a basic grounding in skills useful to the Amarr capsuleer embarking on a career as an Explorer. Further development in skills suitable for exploration and treasure-hunting in New Eden can be achieved by training the certified skill plans for Explorers.

Magnate: AIR Amarr Explorer is the suggested starting ship for this career.

name: Amarr Treasure Hunter
description:
Amarr Explorers focused on treasure hunting start by flying Tech 1 Amarr frigates, specializing in ships designed for exploration, such as the Magnate: Amarr Explorer. A Treasure Hunter's ability to discover valuable resources will be improved by skills for probe scanning, a vital tool for explorers.

Treasure Hunters will also gain an advantage by training hacking and archaeology skills that improve their ability to delve into data and relic sites containing the loot they seek.

To learn more about exploration and discover related activities, head to the Cosmic Signatures panel in the Agency.

name: AIR Industrialist - Entrepreneur
description: Completion of this AIR skill plan gives a basic grounding in skills useful to the capsuleer embarking on a career as an Industrialist focused on entrepreneurial pursuits. Further development in skills suitable for industrial work such as hauling and salvaging can be achieved by training the certified skill plans for Industrialists.

name: AIR Industrialist - Producer
description: Completion of this AIR skill plan gives a basic grounding in skills useful to the capsuleer embarking on a career as an Industrialist focused on production. Further development in skills suitable for industrial work such as manufacturing and mining can be achieved by training the certified skill plans for Industrialists.

name: Alpha Miner
description:
Industrialists focused on mining will start their career as an Alpha Miner flying in the Venture: Industrialist - Alpha Miner mining frigate, with their skills focusing on resource harvesting and reprocessing. Miners are the backbone of the economy, harvesting, and processing all of the raw materials needed for manufacturers to create goods and products.

Miners will also benefit from trade and social skills enabling them to increase their profits from selling materials and completing missions.

Head to the Agency's Resource Harvesting panel to discover nearby mining locations or to the Mining Agents to find suitable jobs.

name: Hauler
description:
Industrialists focused on hauling cargo will start their career flying in industrial haulers such as the Iteron Mark V: Industrialist - Hauler, with their skills focusing on defenses and improving the profits of market transactions, such as contracts.

Hauler pilots make their ISK by taking on contracts from other capsuleers and factions, hauling valuable cargo between space stations and other locations across New Eden. Navigation and ship-handling skills are therefore very useful for speeding up cargo runs.

To find suitable mission agents, head to the Distribution Agents panel in the Agency.

name: Manufacturer
description:
Industrialists focused on manufacturing will start their career flying in industrial haulers such as the Iteron Mark V: Industrialist - Hauler, giving them the ability to move raw materials and their products around in bulk. Manufacturers naturally train skills with a focus on manufacturing and trading.

Given the need to travel when sourcing raw materials and transporting their products, skills for defense, navigation, and ship performance are also very useful to Manufacturers.

name: Omega Miner
description:
Industrialists focused on mining will start their career as an Omega Miner flying mining frigates like Venture: Industrialist - Alpha Miner, before moving on to mining barges such as the Procurer: Industrialist - Omega Miner. Miners train skills for resource harvesting and reprocessing. These pilots are the backbone of the economy, harvesting, and processing all of the raw materials needed by manufacturers.

Miners will also benefit from trade and social skills enabling them to increase their profits from selling materials and completing missions.

Head to the Agency's Resource Harvesting panel to discover nearby mining locations or to the Mining Agents to find suitable jobs.

name: Salvager
description:
Industrialists focused on salvaging will start their career flying in destroyers suitable for salvaging work, such as the Cormorant: Industrialist - Salvager, before eventually advancing to specialized ships. Salvagers train skills focused on enhancing their salvage equipment's efficiency and improving their ability to handle multiple salvage targets.

Salvagers can move large distances across New Eden, often in dangerous territory, so skills improving navigation and defense are also very useful to such pilots.

name: Amarr Bounty Hunter
description:
Amarr Enforcers focused on bounty hunting start their career flying Tech 1 Amarr frigates before moving on to destroyers, such as the Coercer: Amarr Enforcer. Bounty Hunter combat performance benefits from numerous skills enhancing defenses and ship handling.

Bounty Hunters will further enhance their ability to eliminate their targets by training skills to improve the damage, accuracy, and range of their weapon systems.

To find suitable targets, head to the Combat Anomalies panel in the Agency.

name: Amarr Mission Runner
description:
Amarr Enforcers focused on mission running start their career flying Tech 1 Amarr frigates before moving on to destroyers, such as the Coercer: Amarr Enforcer. Mission Runner combat performance benefits from numerous skills enhancing weapons, defenses, and ship handling.

Mission Runners will also gain an advantage by training social skills to improve their relations with agents, increase access to missions, and enhance the rewards for their work.

To find suitable mission agents, head to the Security Agents panel in the Agency.

name: Amarr Militia Fighter
description:
Amarr Soldiers of Fortune focused on militia warfare start their career flying tech 1 Amarr combat frigates, such as the Punisher: Amarr Soldier of Fortune. Amarr Militia Fighters battle other capsuleers for control over space and resources, in the name of the Amarr Empire.

Militia Fighters train skills focusing on combat and survivability, as well as diplomatic skills that increase rewards and standings from corporations, and the use of boosters to give themselves an edge in combat.

To learn more about the Militia Fighter career, head to the Faction Warfare panel in the Agency.

name: Amarr Pirate
description:
Amarr Soldiers of Fortune focused on piracy start their career flying tech 1 Amarr combat frigates, such as the Punisher: Amarr Soldier of Fortune. Pirates roam around New Eden, hunting other capsuleers in low-security space for infamy and ISK, while running from security forces such as CONCORD.

Pirates will train skills focusing on combat and survivability, and the use of boosters to give themselves an edge in combat.

To join other capsuleers in a fleet, head to the Fleet Up! panel in the Agency. Caution is advised. Other pirates might misuse your trust.
